keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 5 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 15 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

keywords.name: LLM agents
keywords.about: Agents plan, use tools, and get evaluated on long-horizon tasks with memory and feedback.

keywords.name: In-context learning
keywords.about: Visual and multimodal in-context learning, with work on removing textual shortcuts and theory-of-mind gaps.

keywords.name: Retrieval distractors
keywords.about: Fine-grained retrieval benchmarks probe distractor handling and evidence-position bias in long contexts.

keywords.name: Safety probes
keywords.about: Probing and steering safety-relevant behaviours, and auditing behavioral detectors and latent harm monitors.

keywords.name: Partial observability
keywords.about: Planning with memory and belief state under partial observations in text and multi-actor worlds.

keywords.name: Camera motion
keywords.about: Reconstructing hands, room layouts, and moving regions from egocentric video under camera motion.

keywords.name: Chain-of-thought
keywords.about: Behavioral counterfactuals probe reasoning traces, while speculative drafts accelerate long chain-of-thought decoding.

keywords.name: Scaling laws
keywords.about: Scaling laws for safety probes and reward models, and whether reasoning gains need bigger models.

keywords.name: Synthetic data
keywords.about: Differentially private and spectrally matched synthetic data for pretraining, guardrails, and hand reconstruction.

keywords.name: MCP
keywords.about: Compares handshake overhead and tool integration strategies for agent communication protocols.

keywords.name: Coding agents
keywords.about: Agents verify, test, and optimize real-world software, exposing specification-oracle gaps in benchmarks.

keywords.name: Diffusion language models
keywords.about: Constrained decoding, token commitment, quantization, and jailbreak transfer for diffusion language models.

keywords.name: Object identity
keywords.about: Training-free reasoning about object identity in video-language models and metadata-heavy grounding tasks.

keywords.name: World models

themes.summary: Papers evaluate LLM judges, agentic and multimodal benchmarks, and fact-checking or QA evaluation designs. They vary judge prompts, aggregate scores, and benchmark construction to expose instability and hidden failures.

themes.name: Sycophancy, safety probes, and guardrails

themes.name: World models for embodied agents and video
themes.summary: Papers introduce, survey, and evaluate world models for agents, robots, and video generation, spanning latent prediction, three-dimensional/four-dimensional scene dynamics, and physics-aware simulation. themes.name: Long-horizon agent memory and personalization
themes.summary: Papers study persistent memory for LLM agents, including deletion audits, memory-guided knowledge acquisition, preference learning, and memory safety before action. themes.name: Vision-language-action models for robotic manipulation
themes.summary: Papers develop and analyze VLA policies for manipulation, loco-manipulation, multi-robot collaboration, and runtime monitoring. They differ in multi-view routing, mixture-of-experts, task-status signals, and flow-matching inference.

themes.name: RAG pipelines, retrieval, and chunking
themes.summary: Papers optimize retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, including chunking under document revisions, hybrid retrieval, agentic retrieval assessment, and graph-based retrieval. They differ in evaluating update cost, retrieval scores, and hierarchical or learned sparse retrieval.

themes.name: 3D Gaussian splatting and scene reconstruction
themes.summary: Papers reconstruct three-dimensional/four-dimensional scenes using Gaussian splatting, feed-forward models, and semantic fields, with applications in driving, surgery, and room layouts. They differ in dynamic motion decoupling, relighting, open-vocabulary segmentation, and long-horizon reconstruction.

themes.name: KV cache compression and MoE quantization
themes.summary: Papers reduce inference memory and cost via KV-cache sharing, compression, offloading, and mixed-precision quantization of mixture-of-experts models. They differ in routing-aware eviction, draft-model compression, SSD lifetime, and accelerator co-design.

themes.name: Test-time adaptation and reasoning scaling
themes.summary: Papers study test-time adaptation for navigation, EEG, and meta-RL, plus test-time reasoning scaling through pruning, routing, and early stopping. They differ in feedback efficiency, memory augmentation, and budget allocation across reasoning formats.

themes.name: GUI and web agents for computer use
themes.summary: Papers build benchmarks and methods for GUI grounding, personalized mobile agents, web research, and app-world reconstruction. They differ in diagnostic evaluation, memory graphs, frontend continuity, and reusable agent-bound UI.

themes.name: Diffusion language models and unmasking decoding
themes.summary: Papers study diffusion language models' constrained decoding, token commitment, remasking, quantization, and learned unmasking policies. They differ in joint compatibility, few-step decoding, temporal quantization, and protein multimodal unification.

themes.name: Prompt injection and jailbreak attacks on agents
themes.summary: Papers examine prompt injection, jailbreak transfer, phishing, and social-engineering attacks against LLM agents and diffusion models. They differ in adaptive email-agent benchmarks, Petri-net execution harnesses, multimodal detection, and harmful-response templates.

highlights.authors: Xiaomin Yu, Hongliang Chen, Zhe Huang et al.
highlights.theme: GUI and web agents for computer use

highlights.key_result: The paper introduces OpenDS-World, a benchmark comprising 200 challenging tasks, and evaluates 12 frontier models under a unified tool environment and execution protocol; the best-performing model achieves 39.0% accuracy, while human evaluation across 1,000 independent attempts yields 21.1% accuracy.

highlights.title: When One Step Is Enough: An Empirical Study of Euler Integration in Flow-Matching Policies
highlights.authors: Shivakanth Sujit, Luca Nunziante, Rousslan Fernand Julien Dossa et al.
highlights.why: Demonstrates that one-step Euler integration performs on par with multi-step across six flow-matching VLAs, enabling low-latency deployment without extra training.
highlights.key_result: Across six flow matching VLAs from 450M to 4.7B parameters, plus a 211 M DiT, four simulation benchmarks and a real world Franka suite, we find the assumption that multi-step inference is necessary for task performance does not hold for well-trained large VLAs. highlights.authors: Jiahao Meng, Qize Yang, Yuxuan Wang et al.
highlights.why: Defines video-centered deep research report generation with a new benchmark and rubric, useful for evaluating multimodal evidence synthesis but niche.
highlights.key_result: Across 18 agent configurations, the best system scores 63.3 out of 100. Current agents still need broader content coverage, stronger causal and logical analysis across modalities, and more accurate citation support.

highlights.title: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
highlights.authors: Advait Gupta, Sachin Konan, Tom Yin et al.
highlights.why: Provides a unified offline benchmark for agentic visual understanding across domains, offering cheaper complementary evaluation to interactive simulators.
highlights.key_result: The paper introduces AgentVQA, an offline benchmark built by manually selecting 1000 challenging, real-world agent examples from 23 source datasets across five agent domains; across the 22 evaluated models, the best achieves only 58.5% accuracy.
evidence: To address this gap, we introduce AgentVQA, an offline benchmark for evaluating VLMs on realistic agentic scenarios across five agent domains: Web Agents, Robotics, Egocentric Videos, Games, and Spatial Planning. We build AgentVQA by manually selecting 1000 challenging, real-world agent examples from 23 source datasets and adapting them for reliable offline evaluation. The resulting benchmark preserves realistic scenarios from interactive environments across diverse domains, and its model rankings track those from corresponding online evaluations. Across the 22 evaluated models, the best achieves only 58.5% accuracy.
Our results show that these capabilities remain far from solved: among 22 state-of-the-art VLMs, the strongest model achieves only 58.5% accuracy.

news.title: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK partner to advance AI safety and security
news.summary: OpenAI and Poland's NASK National Research Institute signed an agreement to collaborate on AI safety, security and technical research, with NASK's AI Safety Research Center acting as the Polish AI Safety Institute. The text also notes that in July CERT Polska, which operates within NASK, used OpenAI models through Daybreak to help find six vulnerabilities in MikroTik RouterOS, for which the vendor released fixes.

news.title: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
news.summary: OpenAI made the Decisions API generally available, built with GPT-6 Luna and described as up to 10x faster than GPT-6 Luna through the Responses API for bounded-answer questions from text, images and structured inputs. Since beta it added a native GPT-Live integration, prompt caching, US and EU inference residency, and support for up to 400 questions per request (twice the previous limit).

news.title: What FDE means at OpenAI
news.summary: OpenAI's Colin Jarvis described the Forward Deployed Engineering team, founded in early 2025 to close the "deployment gap" between model capability and reliable use. The post cites a mid-2025 engagement with about 15 FDEs working on 10+ use cases with a large semiconductor customer, and John Deere's use of OpenAI APIs for its See & Spray precision weed-control technology, which can reduce chemical use by up to 70%.

news.title: Beyond tree cover: mapping the world’s forest types
news.summary: Google DeepMind and Google Research, with the World Resources Institute and IIASA, released Forest Typology (ForTy) 2020, a global 10-by-10-meter map classifying land into six forest and land-use types, plus an early time series tracking annual change from 2017 to 2025. The map is presented as a baseline for the EU's deforestation regulation (EUDR), which requires products not originate from land that was forest in 2020 and since converted to agriculture.

news.title: Flint-interactive: A language for creating interactive data visualizations
news.summary: Microsoft Research introduced Flint-interactive, a language on top of Flint that lets users and agents specify interactive chart behaviors via high-level semantic events and update operators, with Flint's compiler handling interaction logic and visual dependencies. It is presented as addressing high generation cost and reliability problems in having agents produce interactive visualizations, and supports linked views connecting charts, text, tables and application state.

news.title: NVIDIA Unveils Minerva to Bring End-to-End Observability for AI Factories
news.summary: NVIDIA launched Minerva, an AIOps platform that combines telemetry from infrastructure and AI workloads and applies supervised and unsupervised ML to build a dynamic knowledge graph of GPUs, SuperNICs, switches and cables. It analyzes billions of data points per hour and includes a native AI assistant; IREN, Aolani, Bitdeer AI, IBM, Jio, Lambda, Quake AI and Tesla plan to deploy it, and Dell Technologies, Lenovo and Supermicro will offer it in AI factory operations portfolios.

news.title: Cloud Deployment Incoming: ‘Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4’ Arrives on GeForce NOW
news.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launched on GeForce NOW, with Ultimate members getting ray tracing in the campaign via newly added GeForce RTX 5080-class performance. Existing supported Fire TV Stick users can now buy one-month Performance or Ultimate memberships through Amazon, and six games joined the library this week, including FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE and The Elder Scrolls Online's Greymoor Chapter for ESO Standard Edition owners.

news.title: Leading European Financial Services Organizations Embrace Open Models to Build Proprietary Intelligence
news.summary: At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA described European financial firms building models on its accelerated computing and open weight models, including Revolut's PRAGMA foundation model servicing an initial 80 million customers and engineered to scale 3x, and Lloyds' ATUM transaction model built with RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs. Other cited results include bunq's Finn at 60% of the cost per answer, Stripe's 42x faster data pipelines and 92% cost savings in offline testing, and LSEG analyzing tick data up to 10x faster.

news.title: NVIDIA Cosmos Opens New Tools to Train, Evaluate and Deploy World Models
news.summary: NVIDIA expanded its Cosmos platform with training tools, simulation checkpoints and Cosmos Data Factory blueprints, including five cloud-native blueprints available through GitHub, Microsoft Azure, Nebius and CoreWeave. Cited uses include Porsche's shared AV data flywheel, expected to reduce repeated physical test drives by up to 90% and shorten development cycles by up to 85%, and ANYbotics generating over 1,500 synthetic video clips; MicroAGI distilled a 32-billion-parameter Cosmos 3 reasoner to 8 billion parameters.

news.title: How to Read Data into GPU Memory in Python with NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage
news.summary: The post explains how to use NVIDIA KvikIO's Python and C++ interfaces above the cuFile C API to read data directly into GPU memory via GPUDirect Storage, and how KvikIO and cuFile make separate path-selection decisions between the nvidia-fs accelerated path and a CPU-staged compatibility path. It describes settings such as KVIKIO_COMPAT_MODE, KVIKIO_GDS_THRESHOLD and cufile.json options, and per-process statistics via CUFILE_STATS_LEVEL=3 and gds_stats.

news.title: Running Frontier-Class AI Models Across 8 NVIDIA DGX Spark Nodes
news.summary: NVIDIA announced official support for eight-node DGX Spark clusters, scaling unified memory to 1 TB and enabling local serving of the full GLM 5.3 (753B) model, at roughly 80 tokens per second for GLM 5.3 Flash. Benchmarks show decode scaling from about 12 tokens per second on one node to 52 on eight with Qwen3.8-27B (NVFP4), a 7.79x pretraining speedup at 97.4% scaling efficiency, and the RoCEnante collective backend giving a 4.43x decode speedup at eight nodes versus 3.05x without it.

news.title: Turning Database Grading into RL Rewards: Post-Training Agents with ThinkingBox
news.summary: Microsoft and Hugging Face described Turning Database Grading into RL Rewards: using executable checks of final database state as rewards to post-train Qwen3.8-27B with GRPO for 50 steps, raising pass@1 from 51.70% to 60.78% and tasks passing all 20 attempts from 38 to 107, while pass@20 fell from 453 to 446 tasks. ThinkingBox-Bench contains 507 tasks, each evaluated 20 times (10,140 attempts).

news.title: OlmoEarth v1.3: State-of-the-art embeddings for the whole planet
news.summary: Hugging Face released OlmoEarth v1.3, a satellite embedding model producing one 128-dimensional vector per 10-meter pixel (with a 64-dimension version), plus precomputed annual global embeddings on Source Cooperative and a browser-based Embeddings Explorer. Its 128-dim embeddings scored highest on 20 of 27 evaluations against AlphaEarth Foundations and Tessera v2; training took 53% of v1.2's compute time and 18% of v1's, with weights, data and code open.

news.title: Ensemble forecasting with IBM Granite time-series models
news.summary: Hugging Face described Granite Timeseries Ensemble, a recipe combining four open pretrained IBM Granite models (PatchTST-FM-r1, PatchTST-FM-r2, FlowState-r1.1 and TTM-r3) into median and quantile forecasts without retraining or fitted weights. It offers a default Probabilistic Ensemble with uniform probability pooling and an adaptive IQR Ensemble weighting members by forecast spread, with quantiles by default ranging from 0.1 to 0.9.

news.title: Amazon Polly delivers a major upgrade to its Generative engine
news.summary: Amazon Polly upgraded its Generative engine with more expressive, accurate speech at low latency, adding 14 new voices across 9 locales and making Hindi and Finnish generally available on the engine for the first time. The catalog now totals 57 generative voices across 11 languages and 25 locales, with expansion to AWS GovCloud (US-West) for 11 AWS Regions; the upgrade is drop-in with unchanged voice names and API calls.

news.title: How IskayPet unified corporate knowledge with Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Bases
news.summary: AWS described how IskayPet built a corporate knowledge assistant on Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Bases, covering retail operations, veterinary care, people and onboarding, and procurement in four languages across three countries. The company has more than 330 stores in Spain, Portugal and France, over 4,500 employees and 7 million customers, with hundreds of SharePoint documents; the solution was built with Kiro and Claude Haiku 4.5 and uses a native SharePoint connector, hybrid search and managed reranking.

news.title: Announcing new ways to customize models with SageMaker AI, without managing GPUs
news.summary: AWS announced the general availability of training sessions in Amazon SageMaker AI serverless model customization, letting customers write and coordinate their own post-training loop while SageMaker handles GPU allocation, distributed execution, fault recovery and checkpoint storage. Supported techniques include SFT, DPO, RLVR, RLAIF and multi-turn RL, with LoRA or full fine-tuning; customers cited include ImagineSoftware and a team that fine-tuned gpt-oss-20b against an Amazon Neptune knowledge graph.

news.title: Write your own training loop — without managing GPUs — with Amazon SageMaker training session APIs
news.summary: The post details SageMaker AI training session APIs, which expose operations such as forward_backward(), optim_step() and sample() as SageMaker API calls against a live, stateful GPU-backed session so the model stays loaded across steps. Three SDK clients (ServiceClient, TrainingClient, SamplingClient) organize the API, and a cookbook provides SFT and RL recipes, including a minimal RL loop on GSM8K and RL on competitive programming problems graded by unit tests.

highlights.title: Deep Search in Real-World Web Environments
highlights.authors: Xiaomin Yu, Hongliang Chen, Zhe Huang et al.
highlights.theme: GUI and web agents for computer use
highlights.why: 引入了一个实时网络深度搜索基准，要求智能体从多种真实世界来源自主收集和整合证据，填补了静态检索之外的重要评估空白。
highlights.key_result: 本文介绍了 OpenDS-World，一个包含 200 个挑战性任务的基准，并在统一的工具环境和执行协议下评估了 12 个前沿模型；表现最好的模型达到 39.0% 的准确率，而人类在 1,000 次独立尝试中的评估准确率为 21.1%。
evidence: Building on this task formulation, we construct OpenDS-World, a benchmark comprising 200 challenging tasks spanning diverse information modalities, heterogeneous file formats, and interactive access requirements, with independent human verification to ensure evidence validity and answer uniqueness.
We evaluate 12 frontier models under a unified tool environment and execution protocol.
The best-performing model achieves 39.0% accuracy, while human evaluation across 1,000 independent attempts yields 21.1% accuracy.

highlights.title: Making MLLM Latents Matter: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning for Cinematic Video Generation
highlights.authors: Songlin Yang, Zhe Wang, Xiaotong Zhao et al.
highlights.theme: World models for embodied agents and video
highlights.why: 凭借 71 个点赞，因子感知预测学习使 MLLM 潜在表示可用于电影级视频生成，解决了因子感知控制和时间推理问题。
highlights.key_result: 在多镜头生成中，FAPL 的 FaceSim-Arc 得分为 0.523，而 Omni-Video 2 (1.3B) 为 0.412，Omni-Video 2 (14B) 为 0.468，UniVideo (13B) 为 0.451。在第三阶段，与纯文本训练相比，混合观测训练将 Motion Order 从 57% 提高到 61%，并将平移误差从 0.0629 降低到 0.0586，旋转误差从 1.26 降低到 1.02 弧度。
evidence: For multi-shot generation, FAPL achieves a FaceSim-Arc score of 0.523, compared with 0.412 for Omni-Video 2 (1.3B), 0.468 for Omni-Video 2 (14B), and 0.451 for UniVideo (13B).

For Stage III, mixed-observation training improves Motion Order from 57% to 61% and reduces translation and rotation errors from 0.0629 to 0.0586 and from 1.26 to 1.02 radians, respectively, compared with text-only training.

highlights.title: Is Complex Agentic Memory Always Needed? Naive RAG Is Stronger Than We Thought
highlights.authors: Zhengye Bao, Shengtao Zhang, Haokai Zhang et al.
highlights.why: 表明简单的原始历史 RAG 基线在大多数基准上优于复杂的智能体记忆系统，挑战了复杂记忆架构的必要性。
highlights.key_result: 在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval、MEME 和 MemoryAgentBench 上，Raw-RAG 是一种使用稠密检索并对原始历史进行重排序的朴素 RAG 基线，在七个基准-模型设置中的六个上排名第一，比最强对比智能体记忆系统高出 0.13--5.53 分。
evidence: Across LoCoMo, LongMemEval, MEME, and MemoryAgentBench, Raw-RAG ranks first among the compared memory systems in six of seven benchmark--model settings, outperforming the strongest compared agentic memory system by 0.13--5.53 points.

Raw-RAG achieves the highest score among the compared memory systems in six of seven benchmark--model settings, excluding Full-context. It leads LoCoMo by 0.65--0.95 points, LongMemEval by 0.13 points, GPT-4o-mini MEME by 2.24 points, and MemoryAgentBench by 4.48--5.53 points.
Across four benchmarks, Raw-RAG, a naive baseline using dense retrieval and reranking over raw history, ranks first among the compared memory systems in six of seven benchmark--model settings.

highlights.title: When One Step Is Enough: An Empirical Study of Euler Integration in Flow-Matching Policies
highlights.authors: Shivakanth Sujit, Luca Nunziante, Rousslan Fernand Julien Dossa et al.
highlights.why: 证明了一步 Euler 积分在六个流匹配 VLA 上与多步推理表现相当，无需额外训练即可实现低延迟部署。
highlights.key_result: 在六个参数从 450M 到 4.7B 的流匹配 VLA 以及一个 211 M DiT 上，结合四个仿真基准和一个真实世界 Franka 套件，我们发现对于训练良好的大型 VLA，多步推理是任务性能所必需的假设并不成立。在多步推理有帮助的情况下，收益集中在长时任务上的较小模型。
evidence: Across six flow matching VLAs from 450M to 4.7B parameters, plus a 211 M DiT, four simulation benchmarks and a real world Franka suite, we find the assumption that multi-step inference is necessary for task performance does not hold for well-trained large VLAs. Where multi-step helps, the benefit is localised to smaller models on long-horizon tasks.

highlights.title: Verus-Insight: Towards Explainable Artifact Detection in AI-Generated Videos
highlights.authors: Zhuoran Zhang, Yang Shi, Qixun Wang et al.
highlights.why: 提出了面向 AI 生成视频的可解释伪影检测，具有结构化推理和基准，对检测器的可解释性很有用。
highlights.key_result: Verus-Insight 在各种基准上实现了强大的视频级检测性能；与其 Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干相比，RewardData 的 BA 从 48.81 提高到 94.79，Verus-Bench 从 66.67 提高到 89.06，同时 Artifact-Bench T1 从 50.80 提高到 66.60。它还在 Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干基础上一致改进了 Plan F1 和 Finding F1，其中 Verus-Bench Plan F1 从 17.08 提高到 24.70，Finding F1 从 7.56 提高到 15.97；RewardData Plan F1 从 18.67 上升到 31.33，而 Finding F1 从 3.38 增加到 35.42。
evidence: Table shows that Verus-Insight achieves strong video-level detection performance across diverse benchmarks. Compared with its Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, Verus-Insight improves RewardData from 48.81 to 94.79 BA and Verus-Bench from 66.67 to 89.06 BA, while increasing Artifact-Bench T1 from 50.80 to 66.60.

As shown in Table , Verus-Insight consistently improves both Plan F1 and Finding F1 over its Qwen3-VL-8B backbone. On Verus-Bench, Plan F1 increases from 17.08 to 24.70 and Finding F1 from 7.56 to 15.97; on RewardData, Plan F1 rises from 18.67 to 31.33, while Finding F1 increases markedly from 3.38 to 35.42.

highlights.title: Rethinking Sequence Compression with Test-time Regression
highlights.authors: Sihan Yang, Jie Huang, Hanxuan Li et al.
highlights.theme: KV cache compression and MoE quantization
highlights.why: 引入测试时回归作为一种通用的序列压缩原语，提高了分块注意力和视觉 token 合并的效率。
highlights.key_result: 在分块稀疏注意力上，TTR-Compressor 大幅提升了 RULER 性能，优于基于注意力的压缩器。在视觉 token 合并方面，它一致优于标准 MLP 合并器，并在视觉 token 减少 55.6% 的情况下达到相同性能。
evidence: On block-wise sparse attention, TTR-Compressor improves RULER performance over attention-based compressors by a large margin. For visual token merging, it consistently outperforms the standard MLP merger and matches its performance with 55.6% fewer visual tokens.

highlights.title: Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports
highlights.authors: Jiahao Meng, Qize Yang, Yuxuan Wang et al.
highlights.why: 定义了以视频为中心的深度研究报告生成，并提供了新的基准和评分标准，对评估多模态证据综合有用，但相对小众。
highlights.key_result: 在 18 种智能体配置中，最好的系统得到 63.3 分（满分 100）。当前智能体仍需要更广泛的内容覆盖、跨模态更强的因果和逻辑分析以及更准确的引用支持。
evidence: Across 18 agent configurations, the best system scores 63.3 out of 100. Current agents still need broader content coverage, stronger causal and logical analysis across modalities, and more accurate citation support.

highlights.title: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
highlights.authors: Advait Gupta, Sachin Konan, Tom Yin et al.
highlights.why: 提供了一个跨领域的智能体视觉理解统一离线基准，作为交互式模拟器的低成本补充评估。
highlights.key_result: The paper introduces AgentVQA, an offline benchmark built by manually selecting 1000 challenging, real-world agent examples from 23 source datasets across five agent domains; across the 22 evaluated models, the best achieves only 58.5% accuracy.
evidence: To address this gap, we introduce AgentVQA, an offline benchmark for evaluating VLMs on realistic agentic scenarios across five agent domains: Web Agents, Robotics, Egocentric Videos, Games, and Spatial Planning. We build AgentVQA by manually selecting 1000 challenging, real-world agent examples from 23 source datasets and adapting them for reliable offline evaluation. The resulting benchmark preserves realistic scenarios from interactive environments across diverse domains, and its model rankings track those from corresponding online evaluations. Across the 22 evaluated models, the best achieves only 58.5% accuracy.
Our results show that these capabilities remain far from solved: among 22 state-of-the-art VLMs, the strongest model achieves only 58.5% accuracy.

news.title: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK partner to advance AI safety and security
news.summary: OpenAI 与波兰 NASK 国家研究机构签署协议，在 AI 安全、安全性和技术研究方面开展合作，NASK 的 AI 安全研究中心将作为波兰 AI 安全研究所。文中还提到，七月，在 NASK 内运作的 CERT Polska 通过 Daybreak 使用 OpenAI 模型帮助发现 MikroTik RouterOS 中的六个漏洞，厂商已为此发布修复补丁。

news.title: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API
news.summary: OpenAI 将 Decisions API 正式发布，基于 GPT-6 Luna 构建，据称对于来自文本、图像和结构化输入的有限答案问题，通过 Responses API 的速度最高比 GPT-6 Luna 快 10 倍。自测试版以来，它新增了原生 GPT-Live 集成、提示缓存、美国及欧盟推理驻留，并支持每个请求最多 400 个问题（此前限制的两倍）。

news.title: What FDE means at OpenAI
news.summary: OpenAI 的 Colin Jarvis 介绍了 Forward Deployed Engineering 团队，该团队成立于 2025 年初，旨在弥合模型能力与可靠使用之间的“部署差距”。文章提到 2025 年中期与一家大型半导体客户合作，约 15 名 FDE 参与 10+ 多个用例；还提到 John Deere 使用 OpenAI API 实现其 See & Spray 精准除草技术，最多可减少 70% 的化学品使用。

news.title: Beyond tree cover: mapping the world’s forest types
news.summary: Google DeepMind 和 Google Research 联合 World Resources Institute 和 IIASA 发布了 Forest Typology (ForTy) 2020，这是一张全球 10 米 x 10 米地图，将土地分为六种森林和土地利用类型，并提供早期时间序列，追踪 2017 至 2025 年的年度变化。该地图被作为欧盟森林砍伐法规（EUDR）的基线，要求产品不得来自 2020 年时为森林、此后转为农业的土地。

news.title: Flint-interactive: A language for creating interactive data visualizations
news.summary: Microsoft Research 推出了 Flint-interactive，一种建立在 Flint 之上的语言，允许用户和智能体通过高级语义事件和更新操作符指定交互式图表行为，由 Flint 编译器处理交互逻辑和视觉依赖。它旨在解决让智能体生成交互式可视化时存在的高生成成本和可靠性问题，并支持连接图表、文本、表格和应用状态的联动视图。

news.title: NVIDIA Unveils Minerva to Bring End-to-End Observability for AI Factories
news.summary: NVIDIA 推出了 Minerva，一个 AIOps 平台，结合基础设施和 AI 工作负载的遥测数据，应用监督和无监督机器学习构建 GPU、SuperNIC、交换机和线缆的动态知识图谱。它每小时分析数十亿个数据点，并包含原生 AI 助手；IREN、Aolani、Bitdeer AI、IBM、Jio、Lambda、Quake AI 和 Tesla 计划部署该平台，Dell Technologies、Lenovo 和 Supermicro 将把其纳入 AI 工厂运营产品组合。

news.title: Cloud Deployment Incoming: ‘Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4’ Arrives on GeForce NOW
news.summary: 《使命召唤：现代战争 4》登陆 GeForce NOW，Ultimate 会员可通过新加入的 GeForce RTX 5080 级别性能在战役中获得光线追踪。现有受支持的 Fire TV Stick 用户现在可以通过 Amazon 购买一个月 Performance 或 Ultimate 会员，本周有六款游戏加入游戏库，包括 FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE 以及面向 ESO 标准版用户的《上古卷轴 Online》Greymoor 章节。

news.title: Leading European Financial Services Organizations Embrace Open Models to Build Proprietary Intelligence
news.summary: 在 GTC Berlin 上，NVIDIA 描述了欧洲金融公司基于其加速计算和开放权重模型构建模型，包括 Revolut 的 PRAGMA 基础模型，最初服务 80 million 客户，设计可扩展 3 倍；以及 Lloyds 使用 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU 构建的 ATUM 交易模型。其他引用结果包括 bunq 的 Finn 每个答案成本降低 60%，Stripe 的数据管道速度提高 42 倍，离线测试节省 92% 成本，以及 LSEG 分析逐笔数据速度最高提升 10 倍。

news.title: NVIDIA Cosmos Opens New Tools to Train, Evaluate and Deploy World Models
news.summary: NVIDIA 扩展了 Cosmos 平台，增加训练工具、模拟检查点和 Cosmos Data Factory 蓝图，包括通过 GitHub、Microsoft Azure、Nebius 和 CoreWeave 提供的五个云原生蓝图。引用用例包括 Porsche 的共享自动驾驶数据飞轮，预计可减少最多 90% 的重复物理测试驾驶，缩短最多 85% 的开发周期；ANYbotics 生成了超过 1,500 个合成视频片段；MicroAGI 将 32-billion-parameter 的 Cosmos 3 推理器蒸馏为 8 billion 参数。

news.title: How to Read Data into GPU Memory in Python with NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage
news.summary: 该文章解释了如何使用 NVIDIA KvikIO 的 Python 和 C++ 接口（位于 cuFile C API 之上）通过 GPUDirect Storage 直接将数据读入 GPU 内存，以及 KvikIO 和 cuFile 如何在 nvidia-fs 加速路径和 CPU 暂存兼容路径之间分别做出路径选择决策。它描述了诸如 KVIKIO_COMPAT_MODE、KVIKIO_GDS_THRESHOLD 和 cufile.json 选项等设置，以及通过 CUFILE_STATS_LEVEL=3 和 gds_stats 提供每进程统计信息。

news.title: Running Frontier-Class AI Models Across 8 NVIDIA DGX Spark Nodes
news.summary: NVIDIA 宣布正式支持八节点 DGX Spark 集群，将统一内存扩展到 1 TB，并能够在本地提供完整 GLM 5.3 (753B) 模型服务，对于 GLM 5.3 Flash 约为每秒 80 tokens。基准测试显示，使用 Qwen3.8-27B (NVFP4) 时，解码速度从单节点约 12 tokens/秒扩展到八节点 52 tokens/秒，预训练加速达 7.79 倍，扩展效率为 97.4%，RoCEnante 集合后端在八节点提供 4.43 倍解码加速，而没有它时为 3.05 倍。

news.title: Turning Database Grading into RL Rewards: Post-Training Agents with ThinkingBox
news.summary: Microsoft 与 Hugging Face 描述了将数据库评分转化为 RL 奖励：使用最终数据库状态的可执行检查作为奖励，通过 GRPO 对 Qwen3.8-27B 进行 50 步后训练，将 pass@1 从 51.70% 提高到 60.78%，通过全部 20 次尝试的任务数从 38 增加到 107，而 pass@20 从 453 个任务下降到 446 个任务。ThinkingBox-Bench 包含 507 个任务，每个任务评估 20 次（共 10,140 次尝试）。

news.title: OlmoEarth v1.3: State-of-the-art embeddings for the whole planet
news.summary: Hugging Face 发布了 OlmoEarth v1.3，一个卫星嵌入模型，为每个 10 米像素生成一个 128 维向量（另有 64 维版本），并在 Source Cooperative 上提供预计算的年度全球嵌入，还提供基于浏览器的 Embeddings Explorer。其 128 维嵌入在 27 项评估中有 20 项得分最高，优于 AlphaEarth Foundations 和 Tessera v2；训练计算时间为 v1.2 的 53%，为 v1 的 18%，权重、数据和代码开放。

news.title: Ensemble forecasting with IBM Granite time-series models
news.summary: Hugging Face 描述了 Granite Timeseries Ensemble，一种将四个开放的预训练 IBM Granite 模型（PatchTST-FM-r1、PatchTST-FM-r2、FlowState-r1.1 和 TTM-r3）组合为中位数和分位数预测的方法，无需重新训练或拟合权重。它提供默认的概率集成（均匀概率池化）和自适应 IQR 集成（按预测离散度加权成员），默认分位数范围为 0.1 到 0.9。

news.title: Amazon Polly delivers a major upgrade to its Generative engine
news.summary: Amazon Polly 升级了其 Generative 引擎，提供更具表现力、更准确的低延迟语音，新增 14 种语音，覆盖 9 个区域，并首次在该引擎上正式提供印地语和芬兰语。目前目录共有 57 种生成式语音，涵盖 11 种语言和 25 个区域，并扩展到 AWS GovCloud (US-West) 的 11 个 AWS 区域；此次升级为直接替换，语音名称和 API 调用保持不变。

news.title: How IskayPet unified corporate knowledge with Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Bases
news.summary: AWS 描述了 IskayPet 如何在 Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Bases 上构建企业知识助手，涵盖零售运营、兽医护理、人员与入职以及采购，在三个国家支持四种语言。该公司在西班牙、葡萄牙和法国拥有超过 330 家门店、4,500 多名员工和 7 million 客户，拥有数百份 SharePoint 文档；该解决方案使用 Kiro 和 Claude Haiku 4.5 构建，并使用原生 SharePoint 连接器、混合搜索和托管重排序。

news.title: Announcing new ways to customize models with SageMaker AI, without managing GPUs
news.summary: AWS 宣布 Amazon SageMaker AI 无服务器模型定制中的训练会话全面可用，客户可以编写和协调自己的后训练循环，而 SageMaker 负责 GPU 分配、分布式执行、故障恢复和检查点存储。支持的技术包括 SFT、DPO、RLVR、RLAIF 和多轮 RL，可使用 LoRA 或全参数微调；提到的客户包括 ImagineSoftware，以及一个针对 Amazon Neptune 知识图谱微调 gpt-oss-20b 的团队。

news.title: Write your own training loop — without managing GPUs — with Amazon SageMaker training session APIs
news.summary: 该文章详细介绍了 SageMaker AI 训练会话 API，这些 API 将 forward_backward()、optim_step() 和 sample() 等操作作为 SageMaker API 调用，作用于实时、有状态的 GPU 支持会话，使模型在多个步骤间保持加载状态。三个 SDK 客户端（ServiceClient、TrainingClient、SamplingClient）组织 API，并提供了一本 cookbook 提供 SFT 和 RL 配方，包括 GSM8K 上的最小 RL 循环，以及按单元测试评分的竞赛编程问题上的 RL。
